sentences.en: She was released on the grounds that she was insane.
That is insane. Only a fool would believe that.
sentences.zh: 那真是荒唐至极。只有傻子才会相信那种说法。

sentences.en: To cite usage against rule, in a constructed language, is insane.
sentences.zh: 在人造语言中引用用法来反对规则，这真是疯狂的举动。

senses.zh: 蠢极的，荒唐的；（患）精神病的，疯狂的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（不）+sane（健全的）→精神不健全的→精神病的
